experiment.name: proto-board crop-handoff-001 L2 3-UAV
experiment.note: P0a prototype board: reference baselines, L2 rendered observations (rgb1080-rs camera, inverted MID-360, IMU, GNSS), gz-sim lockstep physics. Spawn pads on the flat roof south-east of the plaza (mesh surface 31.1 m, about 16.6 m above the street): surface spread over +-0.7 m 1.6 / 3.1 / 3.2 cm (Env spawn check 15 cm); minimum distance to actor paths over the 360 s Detour tape (content b1285649, all 3600 ticks, background crowd included) 5.2 / 9.2 / 13.2 m horizontal and 16.7 / 18.4 / 20.7 m 3D, scripted actors 21.5 / 25.3 / 29.2 m horizontal (K07 measurement, 2026-10-21).
